author: homelab
name: SIGMA - Impair defenses - logging/audit/security tooling (Linux)
description: Disabling auditd rules, SELinux, logging services, or the firewall (T1562/T1685/T1686 misses from the lab coverage run).
false_positives: Administrator maintenance of logging or security services

subtechnique.name: Disable or Modify Linux Audit System Log

query: process where event.type == "start" and ((process.command_line like~ ("*auditctl -D*", "*auditctl -e 0*")) or process.command_line:"*setenforce 0*" or (process.command_line like~ ("*stop auditd*", "*disable auditd*", "*stop rsyslog*", "*disable rsyslog*", "*stop syslog*", "*stop systemd-journald*")) or (process.command_line like~ ("*journald.conf*", "*rsyslog.conf*", "*/etc/rsyslog.d*")) or (process.command_line like~ ("*ufw disable*", "*ufw logging off*")))
